countedBy: lane landmarks-r18-c-20261123 from the plane-rectified panoramas b_20250109_1300_Track05_Sphere_00277 (2025, Koningsplein, 40 px/m) and recording_2025-06-19_03-28-47_01537 (2025, Singel side, 40 px/m), with the RCE register text (Koningsplein two window axes, Singel one); not yet blind-counted. Glazed openings, bottom row first: the ground floor is cropped out (hidden behind parked bicycles and blurred figures on both photos); first storey one sash per axis; second storey one French window per axis; third storey a coupled pair of round-arched windows per axis.

facades.name: Koningsplein front
facades.note: Two axes; the third storey couples two round-arched windows per axis with 0.32 m of stone between them. Crop: the flat front above the shop front (the shop windows are hidden behind parked bicycles and blurred figures on both photos, and the 1929-30 shop front is asymmetric by design: side portico on the Koningsplein, mosaic field on the Singel); the round corner tower and its drum (in this face's ortho elevation) are a separate signature item, checked on the tower views.

mixedRows.evidence: nw-277.jpg (b_20250109_1300_Track05_Sphere_00277 rectified onto the Koningsplein front, 40 px/m): the third storey couples its round-arched windows two by two over each axis (x 172-197 / 208-235 and 330-355 / 366-392 px: ~0.3 m of stone inside a pair, ~3 m between the pairs); register: 'twee aan twee gekoppelde rondboogvormige vensters'. The spacing is paired, not a regular row with gaps.

facades.name: Singel front
facades.note: One axis; the third storey couples two round-arched windows. Crop: the flat front above the shop front (the shop windows are hidden behind parked bicycles and blurred figures on both photos, and the 1929-30 shop front is asymmetric by design: side portico on the Koningsplein, mosaic field on the Singel); the round corner tower and its drum (in this face's ortho elevation) are a separate signature item, checked on the tower views.
